narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in New Jersey on the afternoon of September 23. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 3 inches.
ev: US Route 130 in Brooklawn was closed due to flooding.
A vehicle was trapped in flood waters on Broadway in Gloucester City.
The Interstate 78 ramp to Pattenburg Road in Union Township was closed due to flooding.
Washington Road in West Windsor Township was closed due to flooding.
Jersey Avenue in New Brunswick was closed between Tailer Square and Sandford Street due to flooding.
Widespread roadway flooding in Northfield with some roads becoming impassable.
US Route 30 was closed at Baird Boulevard in Camden due to flooding. Several other roads in Camden were closed due to flooding.
